name: expandable-text
title: Expandable text
description: Long text folded to a few lines, with a Show more toggle that appears only when something is actually hidden and moves the height.
docs: children is the text; lines (default 3) is how many lines show folded. The text is measured with a ResizeObserver against the height of those lines, again on resize, on a text change and when a web font arrives, so the toggle exists only while something is cut. In the browser the first measure runs before the first paint, so a client render never shows the toggle late; in server-rendered HTML it appears once the page is live. The whole text is always in the DOM and folded by CSS (a line clamp), so search, translation and screen readers have all of it; the toggle has aria-expanded and aria-controls. Controlled with expanded and onExpandedChange, or uncontrolled with defaultExpanded. moreLabel and lessLabel are the words on the toggle. The height moves over 200ms with the ellipsis switched off for that time, and snaps under reduced motion. textClassName styles the paragraph, className the wrapper; the line height must be a real length (leading-relaxed, not normal).
